prompt: Who laid the foundation stone of Jamia Millia Islamia?
answer: Maulana Mehmud Hasan (also known as Mahmud Hasan Deobandi or Shaikhul Hind) laid the foundation stone of Jamia Millia Islamia at Aligarh on October 29, 1920.
